violations.description: Hardcoded API secret in Dockerfile environment variable
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets from Dockerfiles and pass them securely at runtime.

violations.description: Committed configuration file containing a hardcoded password
violations.recommendation: Remove sensitive credentials from configuration files and use environment variables.

violations.description: Committed environment file containing sensitive database credentials
violations.recommendation: Remove committed .env files and add them to .gitignore.

violations.description: Unsafe pull_request_target trigger combined with PR head checkout and workflow write-all permissions
violations.recommendation: Use pull_request trigger instead of pull_request_target, or avoid checking out and executing untrusted PR code with write permissions.

violations.description: Over-broad write-all permissions assigned at the workflow level
violations.recommendation: Restrict workflow permissions to the minimum required set (e.g. contents: read).

violations.description: Untrusted event comment body interpolated directly into a shell execution context
violations.recommendation: Avoid evaluating untrusted event data directly in shell commands.

violations.description: Machine-specific absolute path in project IDE settings
violations.recommendation: Add .idea/ directory to .gitignore and remove it from version control.

violations.description: Debug mode enabled in local configuration file
violations.recommendation: Disable debug mode in production or deployment configurations.
